decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The existing front boundary treatment shall be retained except at the point of access to the hardstanding.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)
description: Construction of vehicle crossover to front of dwellinghouse
